in_sanskrit.meaning: difficult to approach, hard to overcome, inaccessible

This name is often given to babies who are expected to face challenges and obstacles in life, and is believed to bring strength and resilience.

in_marathi.name: Durgam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durgam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Durgam is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that means fearless. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'durgah', which means fortress or invincible. Durgam is the name of the goddess Durga, who is known for her immense strength and the ability to protect her devotees from evil. The name Durgam is also used as a given name to bestow the qualities of courage, fearlessness, and protection upon the child.
